snippet.title: Too Fun - Official Gameplay Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Too Fun is a midnight TV game show for 2 to 8 friends. Run, push, bluff and talk your way through wild episodes in first person, with proximity voice chat that is always on. Every episode is a new set and a new rule. Win the ratings. Lose your dignity.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5563130/Too_Fun/

Episodes in this trailer
• Fireball Rain: dodge the fireballs, push rivals out of the circle
• Blind Monster: the monster hears every step, so stay quiet
• Roulette Table: the revolver picks someone
• Bomb's On You: pass the bomb before it blows
• Color Floor: run to the called color before the floor breaks
• Musical Chairs, Spotlight, Camera Crane, Shock Grid, Share or Steal, Impostor, One Bullet and more

Features
• Online multiplayer for 2 to 8 players, best with 4 to 8
• Built-in proximity voice chat: your voice can save you or give you away
• A new mix of episodes in a new order every match
• Bunny contestants with hats, outfits and faces
• Practice alone against bots
• Cross-platform: Windows and macOS

Footage recorded from a real playtest night with friends. The laughs are real.
